what: N7: the naming model moves from the profile's configuration (the way the compactor is) to Exosurface's own configuration, once for every surface, so no profile change can drop it. Per-profile naming model choice is lost (machine-level now).
why: Pinned OptChat keeps only the keys it knows in a profile config, so a naming model set there is dropped on the next OptChat settings save and the configured model silently reverts to the default, breaking the owner ruling never to substitute a model silently. Director ruled option 2 (2026-11-05); per-profile via an OptChat upstream change is filed as a separate issue.
evidence: OptChat aae1caf src/profiles.ts:51-55 loadConfig returns only compactor, subagent and the typed SETTINGS keys (settings.ts), dropping 'namer'; src/settings-page.ts:117-120 saves that filtered config via src/index.ts:524-526 and profiles.ts:46 saveConfig. Code review of PR #91 head 01ff2ad, class silent-model-substitution.
